root_idea.summary: A root expressing soundness, rightness, and the opposite of فساد, corruption or disorder.
root_idea.development: The root develops from being sound or right to making something sound, restoring order, and removing estrangement between people.

senses.definition: To be or become sound, right, or righteous; to come into a proper state.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, used of persons who are or have become righteous.

senses.definition: To set right, reform, restore, or improve a person, thing, affair, or condition.
senses.usage_conditions: Includes correcting or restoring something to a sound state, including reforming one's own conduct or affairs.

senses.definition: To reconcile parties, make peace, or restore accord between them.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for removing estrangement and repairing relations between people or groups.

senses.definition: Setting right, reforming, restoring, or improving.
senses.usage_conditions: The verbal noun of أَصْلَحَ in its general sense of bringing a person, affair, or condition into a sound state.
Used specifically for removing discord or restoring agreement between parties.

senses.definition: Righteous or morally good; in substantivized use, a righteous person or a good or righteous act.
senses.usage_conditions: Applied in the Quran to morally upright persons and to good or righteous acts. The feminine plural صالحات is commonly substantivized for righteous deeds.

senses.definition: Ṣāliḥ, the prophet sent to Thamūd.
senses.usage_conditions: A proper name, distinct from the adjective or active participle صَالِح.

senses.definition: Reconciliation, peace, or an agreement ending contention.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for the removal of estrangement and the restoration of peaceful relations between parties.

senses.definition: One who sets right or reforms; a reformer.
senses.usage_conditions: A substantivized active participle of Form IV, used for people engaged in reforming affairs or conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be suitable, fit, or meet for a person, purpose, or use.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction in which something is suitable for or fit for someone or something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make peace or reconciliation with someone; to settle or compromise with another party.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe a settlement on specified terms, including a compromise between a creditor and debtor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To season, prepare, repair, mend, trim, or otherwise make an object fit for use.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to objects, materials, provisions, or equipment requiring preparation or repair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat a person or animal well, benefit them, or do good to them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A benefactive construction with a person or animal as the recipient of good treatment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become rectified, sound, or put right.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A quasi-passive or intransitive counterpart of making something right.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make peace, become reconciled, or come to terms with one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of two people, parties, or a community restoring peaceful relations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To agree among themselves concerning a matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used when people reach an agreement about a specified affair or arrangement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A conventional or technical usage or term established by agreement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to naming or using an expression by convention rather than by its primary lexical application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To regard, esteem, or desire a person or thing as good, sound, right, or proper.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes an evaluative or desiderative stance toward a person or thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek to make something good, sound, or right, including to bring a person into good or obedient conduct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Expresses an effort or aim to produce improvement or good condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek to do good or act well toward someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A benefactive construction directed toward a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek peace or concord.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Expresses an effort to obtain peaceful relations or agreement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn out well or happen in a satisfactory way.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive use describing a favorable outcome.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A formal peaceful compact or settlement, including relinquishment of contention; by extension, something surrendered or taken under such a settlement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes legal or practical settlement language and peaceful surrender rather than capture by force.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A party or group at peace with others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may function as an epithet for people who are in peaceful relations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Goodness, soundness, rightness, rectitude, righteousness, virtue, or honesty; a good or right state or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract noun expressing the opposite of فساد, corruption or disorder.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name of Mecca.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper-name use distinct from the abstract noun meaning goodness or rightness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Suitable, fit, or meet for a purpose or office.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use describing fitness or appropriateness rather than moral righteousness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Much, copious, or frequent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or extended adjectival use, especially of abundant rain or repeated occurrence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A benefit, beneficent act, or advantageous thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine substantive derived from صَالِح, used of something good received from another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cause, means, occasion, or affair conducive to good; a beneficial interest or public good.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Contrasted with مفسدة, something conducive to harm or corruption; plural مصالح.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place, garment, or object requiring repair or mending.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial noun for something to be repaired.

cautions: The identical spelling صَالِح can be the active participle/adjective or the proper name Ṣāliḥ; QAC treats these as separate lexical groups.
The Quranic plural صالحات is presented under the singular active-participle citation form صَالِح.
The Quranic senses are restricted to usages supported by the supplied lexical evidence; additional Classical branches are listed separately.
